Summary.en: Turns a number into its word representation, digit by digit.
Summary.de: Wandelt eine Zahl Ziffer für Ziffer in ihre Wortdarstellung um.
Summary.it: Converte un numero nella sua rappresentazione a parole, cifra per cifra.

Parameter.NumberWords: The array of strings representing the word for each digit from 0 to 9. The index of the string in the array corresponds to the digit it represents.
Parameter.PreFix: The string that shall be prepended to the transformed result.
Parameter.PostFix: The string that shall be appended to the transformed result.

NumberWords.default: The array of strings representing the word for each digit from 0 to 9. The index of the string in the array corresponds to the digit it represents.
